| Resources | Rebuild team composition and role assignments | Affects ownership/approval recommendations for prescribed artifacts |
| BA Planning | No defined elicitation, requirements, or traceability approach | Prescription must include the minimum BA artifacts that make build work executable |

| Registers | Six registers are AI-derived from the brief; no human validation recorded | Prescription treats registers as draft-state records needing validation, not as confirmed facts |

## Conflicts and Assumptions

| Issue | Detail | Resolution Needed |
|-------|--------|-------------------|
| CONTEXT.md vs filesystem | CONTEXT.md reports decision-readiness (95.7%) and next-actions (96.9%) runs with paths that do not exist; folder map omits `artifacts/` | Update CONTEXT.md to reflect actual state, or locate the missing runs |
| Register validation | Registers (AL, BL, D, DEP, ISS, R) are AI-generated from the brief with no human validation record; a PM-briefed team may disagree with ratings | PM validates registers during build-planning |
| Charter constraint vs rebuild intent | Original charter constrained "no custom development"; the rebuild explicitly considers custom development | Confirmed as resolved by the intake brief (rebuild premise), not a live conflict |
| AI-acceleration assumption | Whole schedule premise rests on an unproven assumption | Validate with a scoped build spike during platform selection (per R-01, AL-01) |
